title: Splitting and recombining assignments
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each index in $P$ and to each index outside $P$. Splitting these assignments into their fixed and free parts and then recombining them gives the function on all $n$ indices whose value at each index is the assigned sign for that index.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of indices among the $n$ coordinates
$z$ assigns a sign to each index in $P$
$y$ assigns a sign to each index outside $P$
